subject: Routeing Change - North Atlantic Right Whale - Maritimes, Newfoundland, St. Lawrence
text:
Routeing Change - North Atlantic Right Whale - Maritimes, Newfoundland, St. Lawrence
Effective 222000 UTC Oct 2026, the following North Atlantic Right Whale restriction Zones are in effect for all vessels greater than 13 meters in length overall:
Static Zones North and South: No restriction in effect.
Dynamic Shipping Zones A, B, C, D, and E: No restriction in effect.
Seasonal Management Areas 1 and 2: No restriction in effect.
Restricted area: No restriction in effect.
Voluntary Seasonal Slowdown: There is no slowdown in effect.
Additional details are available in Notices to Mariners. 
Mariners are requested to report whale sightings and observations of entangled, dead, or injured whales to Marine Communication and Traffic Services.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-4397-26
